notes: New 3D exercise animations for every exercise: real gym machines and equipment, fixed hand/foot placement and movement paths, 2s down / 1s up rep tempo, muscle highlights, form cues on the body, pause / slow-mo / scrub, and a 'Wrong way' comparison. Gym upgrades: smart weight suggestions, warm-up sets in the player, saved machine settings, notes per exercise, supersets, a next-set preview while you rest, stuck-lift (deload) alerts, and a best-time-to-go crowd planner.
